en: And here we are! Castelia City, the biggest city in all of Unova!
Whoa... So this is Castelia. The towers go on forever! Team Plasma could be hiding anywhere in a place like this.
Hey, look out there! That ship with the black sails, heading out of the bay... Something about it feels wrong.
I'm going to have a look around. See you, {player}!
Shall we sail back to Virbank City?
Right you are! Step this way!
The ship pulls away from the pier and heads back across the bay toward Virbank City...
Come and find me whenever you fancy a trip. I'm always on this pier!
